_README: VERIFIED ROLE AND STATUS REGISTRY. Every entry is sourced beat reporting or a published snap count, dated, checked 2026-09-15 evening ET. A projection says what a player might do; this says whether he is on the field. When the two disagree, this wins. Nothing in here is inferred. Re-verify anything older than 7 days.

josh jacobs.why: Removed from the Commissioner's Exempt List effective Mon 10-19 (NFL statement 10-16); may practice after GB's Sunday-night game and can play as early as week 7. The personal-conduct investigation remains OPEN: discipline could still come, and any suspension would COUNT the six games already missed on paid leave toward its total (PFR 10-16, the author infers a six-game total is being set up — i.e. likely no further missed games, not confirmed). GB ranks last in rushing (60 yd/g), so the role is his on return. NFL Commissioner's Exempt List since 2026-08-30, not an injury. Pled no contest 2026-09-10; criminal case closed. NFL personal-conduct review still open with NO published timeline. Exempt games COUNT toward any eventual suspension (Maske/FOS) and ~2 are already banked; Schefter 2026-09-13 cites a six-game DV minimum, 'could be more or less'. Nothing reported says season-long.
josh jacobs.call: HOLD, and START when active: a top-10 RB in the #9 December environment for the week 15-17 run. Lloyd and Strong lose most of their value on his return.

ray davis.why: Still listed RB2 behind Cook, but Week 1 usage undercuts it: Davis 5 snaps / 1 carry, practice-squad elevation Frank Gore Jr. 10-11 snaps / 1 carry including third-down pass protection. Rotowire calls him 'a shakier bench stash'. Ty Johnson (RB3) was inactive, so the split may move again.
ray davis.call: HOLD, downgraded. James Cook is the single best asset on this roster (+188 over the wire); insuring him still has value. But this is no longer a hard block — if a genuinely rising player needs the spot, Davis is the piece to move.

DST:HOU.why: Best season defense in the league on two sources (140.5 blended, #1 of 32; Yahoo's own HH-scored projection had them 432.9 vs Chiefs 389.8). Schedule by opponent implied total: 2nd-easiest in weeks 10-14, 4th-easiest in the playoff weeks 15-17 (Chiefs: 17th and 14th). Only weeks 3-9 favour the Chiefs.
DST:HOU.call: HOLD in Heritage House. A 7-acquisition league rations streaming, and Tecmo Bowlers is near-certain to reach a playoff window where this defense has the 4th-best schedule. The 'second DEF is a wasted spot' rule is BSB logic (uncapped adds) and does not transfer.
DST:HOU.reverses: 2026-09-16 07:16 'drop the Texans' — wrong, caught by Caleb

keon coleman.why: WR3 and falling. Week 1: 19 routes (3rd among Bills WRs behind DJ Moore 26 and Khalil Shakir 20), 1 catch on 1 target for 1 yard, plus a failed two-point target. Buffalo added DJ Moore this offseason. Rotowire: 'will likely need an injury ahead of him to have any fantasy appeal.'
keon coleman.call: PROTECTED STATUS LIFTED. He was held as a real WR3 role; Week 1 says the role is not real. Droppable.
keon coleman.reverses: 2026-09-15 HOLD: Bills WR3 behind DJ Moore and Shakir - a real role

calvin ridley.why: Healthy, NOT injured - no designation, not on the injury report. The reason no projection covers him is a ZERO-TARGET Week 1 on 32 snaps, third among Titans WRs behind Carnell Tate (44) and Wan'Dale Robinson (41).
calvin ridley.call: NEXT DROP, not tonight's. One game is one game and he is still on the field. If Week 2 is another blank, he goes.
calvin ridley.stale_trap: An SI headline 'Calvin Ridley out for season after gruesome injury' ranks high in search and is dated 2026-11-16 of the 2025 season. Historical. Do not cite it.

tank dell.why: On IR-designated-to-return since 2026-08-30. Traces to the 2024 Week 16 dislocated knee / torn ACL that cost him all of 2025. Returned to practice early August 2026, not ready. Earliest possible return Week 5, GM Caserio non-committal: 'he's close. He's not quite there.'
tank dell.call: DROP. BSB has no IR slot, so this is a spot worth exactly 0 for four-plus weeks with real bust risk on the far side.

brian burns.why: Torn ACL, believed suffered in Sunday's game (Rapoport/Schefter, reported Mon 2026-09-28 ~7:45 am ET; he had played through ankle pain). An ACL tear ends the season.
brian burns.call: IR, NOT DROP. Heritage House has 3 IR slots and one is free (Garrett holds one): move Burns to IR the moment Yahoo tags him O/IR, which frees his roster spot without losing him. Until the tag lands he cannot be IR'd and is not worth dropping. T.J. Watt (LB,DE — DL-eligible) takes the DL slot.
brian burns.src: Ian Rapoport @RapSheet 2026-09-28, sourced with Adam Schefter (screenshot from Caleb)
brian burns.ir_eligible_when: Yahoo designation O or IR (IR-slot rules SLN28136)

add_yes._priority_note: priority is set by the reasoning in `why`, and outranks the projection gap between verified names. It is the durable form of a judgment call.

rashee rice.designation: O (hamstring) at the 10-13 drop; out wk 6
rashee rice.usage_wk1: KC WR1/2 role when healthy; no change in the depth chart behind him
rashee rice.why: Hamstring strain in week 4, rested through the bye, out week 6. Andy Reid (10-16): "a pretty fast healer", expects a relatively quick recovery after the Chargers game; no plans to place him on IR. Rest-of-season 13.9/wk in HH scoring vs the weakest bench WR 7.2; KC is a top-8 December environment. A playoff-run flex sitting free because he is hurt now. Caleb added him 10-18 for Malik Washington.
rashee rice.src: si.com Chiefs injury report 2026-10-16 (Reid quotes); nbcsports.com player news 2026-10-16; Yahoo HH log (T-rex drop 10-13)

unavailable.jordyn tyson: NO (New Orleans Saints, NOT Arizona - he is an Arizona State product, which is where that error came from). IR-R, right hamstring, ~2 months from 2026-08-30, earliest Week 5, realistically late October. cbssports 2026-08-30; nfl.com

xavier hutchinson.usage_wk1: 44 snaps, 2nd among Texans WRs behind Nico Collins (57). 6 targets, 3 catches, 32 yards.
xavier hutchinson.why: The role cannot be given back. Jayden Higgins tore his ACL in training camp and is on IR for the entire 2026 season. There is no one returning to reclaim these snaps.

demario douglas.usage_wk1: 41 snaps (61%), 33 ROUTES = 79% route share, highest on the team. 7 targets, 5 catches, 22.6% target share.
demario douglas.why: Route share far exceeding snap share means he is on the field for essentially every passing down. A.J. Brown went on IR with a high ankle sprain, out at least 4 weeks and likely nearer 6 - the only player who outranked him for passing-down targets.
demario douglas.caveat: Brown comes back. This is a 4-6 week window, not a season-long role change.
demario douglas.src: rotowire 2026-09-10 box score; rotowire injury analysis 2026-09-15

malachi fields.usage_wk1: 49-50 of 69 snaps (72%), led ALL Giants skill players in snap share on debut. 4 targets, 2 catches, 25 yards. 18 routes = 50% route share.
malachi fields.why: Reported as settling in as the Giants' No. 2 behind Malik Nabers.
malachi fields.caveat: Route share (50%) is well below snap share (72%) - the Giants are using his size to block. Targets will lag the snaps until that changes.

antonio williams.usage_wk1: 26 of 70 snaps (37%), WR4. 4 targets, 4 catches, 64 yards, 1 TD - led the team in receiving yards.
antonio williams.why: Best per-snap efficiency on the board, and as the WR4 the snap count is the number with the most room to rise.

tj hockenson.usage_wk1: 43 of 65 snaps (66%), TE1. 5 targets (2nd on the team behind Justin Jefferson), 4 catches, 36 yards, 1 TD.
tj hockenson.why: Nothing acute explains his availability - no injury, no suspension, no trade. It is a two-year efficiency decline (TE34 in 2024, TE26 in 2025) plus a near 50/50 snap timeshare with Josh Oliver (42 snaps), and the draft market gave up (ADP 161.6, TE26). Week 1 usage contradicts the market.

jonathon brooks.why: Groin, surgery, IR 9-23 for ~6 weeks (earliest ~week 10) and he was the backup to Hubbard before it (5 carries to 12). Not a playoff role.

baker mayfield.why: Dislocated thumb (throwing hand), out since week 3; Bucs EXPECT him back week 7 (not confirmed — grip progressing, swelling after Monday throwing, no practice yet). 1-QB league: a bye/injury cover for Stafford, not a starter upgrade; the planner prices him once Sleeper posts a week-7 number.

mike pittman.why: Plantar fasciitis; short-term IR 10-10, out at least 4 games; PIT bye week 9, so earliest return week 10 vs CIN. A WR2/3 behind Metcalf — a December flex, not a starter. Three weeks of roster spot before he can score.

alec pierce.why: Heel; Pelissero 10-17: "still a few weeks away" — no return week yet. A real IND WR2 role (deep threat) when back; re-check in two weeks, not a roster spot now.

jalen mcmillan.why: Left knee PCL re-injury 9-27, out 6-8 weeks (earliest ~week 10-12); zero catches before it. Not a role worth the wait.

dezhaun stribling.why: Rookie; ankle surgery 9-16, IR, Shanahan "close to 10 weeks" (~week 12); 21 snaps, no targets before it. Not a playoff role.
